title:
From footage
to follow-through.
tag: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon · built Oct 29–Nov 3, 2026
narration: A camera can record an incident without getting help to the right person. EduSphere Safety connects school camera events to a staff response, with evidence and a clear record of who acted.

title:
Detect locally.
Respond together.
narration: The edge agent decodes video, tracks people, and applies scheduled rules. A cloud API stores incidents. The staff console combines evidence review, local Meta Llama briefings, and a recorded response workflow.

title:
A school-specific
safety console.
narration: This is the running application with a real PostgreSQL database. We sign in as the school safety officer. The overview shows enrolled devices and open incidents, while diagnostics identifies camera coverage gaps.

title:
A zone. A schedule.
A repeatable rule.
narration: A school defines a restricted zone and an after-hours schedule. This editor stores the polygon, confidence threshold, persistence, and cooldown in a versioned bundle. Persistence requires multiple frames, so one isolated detection does not trigger this rule.

title:
60 frames.
One zone event.
bullets: One event persisted to the outbox
tag: Synthetic footage · replayed detections, not an accuracy benchmark
narration: This reproducible demo uses synthetic footage and replayed detections. The real FFmpeg decoder, tracker, and rule engine process sixty frames and write one zone event to the persistent outbox. This verifies pipeline behavior, not detector accuracy.

title:
One event.
One incident.
tag: Recorded application · explicit demo handoff from edge outbox
narration: A demo handoff sends the edge outbox event to the real API. Retrying the same event returns the same incident identifier. Staff open that single incident from the inbox.

title:
Context before
action.
bullets: Synthetic clip uploaded via manifest API
tag: Recorded application · supplied synthetic clip, not automatic clip extraction
narration: We upload the synthetic clip through the evidence API and open it from the incident. Playback is authorized through a short-lived link, and access is logged. This supplied test clip gives staff context; automatic live-camera clip extraction remains future work.

title:
A briefing.
A checklist.
Clear unknowns.
tag: Real local Llama inference · inference wait shortened in the edit
narration: Now we ask Meta Llama to draft an incident briefing. It runs locally and receives only authorized event metadata, never camera footage. The structured result gives staff a summary, review steps, and explicit unknowns. It cannot change the incident or take action. Staff verify the draft against the evidence.

title:
Acknowledge.
Investigate. Resolve.
bullets: Actor and note recorded in activity
narration: The officer acknowledges the incident, adds an investigation note, and resolves it. Each transition checks the current version to prevent conflicting updates. The database records the actor and activity. Acknowledgement also cancels pending escalation, connecting the alert to an accountable staff response.

title:
Escalation with
visibility.
tag: Recorded application · local email pickup, not external delivery
narration: Notification policy sets escalation recipients and delays. The worker writes email to a local pickup directory in this demo. Diagnostics shows evidence access and untested cameras, making monitoring gaps visible.

title:
Working prototype.
Clear next steps.
narration: All five hundred and nine existing tests pass, including PostgreSQL integration tests. Next come real-camera validation, measured detector benchmarks, automatic edge delivery, and production sign-in integration.

title:
Make the response
part of the record.
tag: Assistive detection. Human decisions. Accountable response.
narration: EduSphere Safety makes the response part of the record. It assists school staff; it never replaces supervision.
